integrity: Each installable version pins the winget package id, the official installer URL, and the SHA-256 published in the winget manifest. The agent accepts an install only when the live winget manifest matches this pin, then runs a fixed winget argument list. It never accepts a URL, hash, or command from the server.

versions.impact: Installs Python 3.11.9 beside any existing interpreter. Existing installations are not removed or replaced, and PATH is not rewritten by the agent.
Installs Python 3.12.10 beside any existing interpreter. Existing installations are not removed or replaced, and PATH is not rewritten by the agent.
Installs Python 3.13.15 beside any existing interpreter. Existing installations are not removed or replaced, and PATH is not rewritten by the agent.
Installs Node.js 24.22.1 from the official LTS package. An existing compliant Node.js installation is left in place. npm is verified separately and is not installed on its own.

tools.notes: npm ships with Node.js. The agent detects and verifies it separately. It cannot install a standalone npm version, and an exact npm pin is rejected when an environment is published.

versions.impact: Installs Git for Windows 2.56.0.3 when Git is missing or not compliant. User Git configuration is not changed.

Installs Docker Desktop 4.96.3. This does not mean the Docker engine is running. Docker Desktop has its own license, needs virtualization, usually requires administrator approval, and may require a reboot.

tools.notes: Ready only when docker info succeeds. docker --version is not treated as an engine readiness result.
